annotation:
Born and raised in the bustling city of New York, I was the youngest of three siblings. My parents, both immigrants from Italy, instilled in me a deep appreciation for hard work, determination, and the importance of family. Growally up, I was an energetic and curious child, always eager to explore the world around me. I spent countless hours playing in the park, reading books, and engaging in imaginative play.

As I grew older, my interests began to shift towards more social activities. I became involved in a variety of extracurricular activities, including drama club, debate team, and student council. These experiences helped me develop strong communication skills, leadership abilities, and a deep sense of empathy for others. I also discovered a love for travel, and spent several summers abroad, immersing myself in new cultures and broadening my horizons.

After high school, I attended college at a small liberal arts school in New England. It was there that I truly came into my own, developing a strong sense of self and a clearer understanding of my goals and aspirations. I majored in psychology, and became deeply interested in the study of human behavior, motivation, and emotion.

Upon graduation, I decided to pursue a career in counseling. I enrolled in a graduate program at a local university, and quickly found my niche working with adolescents and young adults. Over the years, I have worked with clients facing a wide range of challenges, including depression, anxiety, trauma, and substance abuse. I have also had the privilege of working with many talented and dedicated colleagues, who have inspired me to continue growing and learning as a professional.

Outside of my work, I enjoy spending time with my loved ones, exploring new places, and indulging in my passions for music, art, and literature. I believe that life is a journey, and that each day presents us with new opportunities to learn, grow, and connect with others. I am grateful for all that I have accomplished so far, and excited to see what the future holds.
